We see the only cheap options are $584 for 100 mg, exceeding budget. The butadiene cost $161.7. Total > $745. So not acceptable.

We need alternative route with cheaper precursors.

Look at other templates from earlier list. The first template (1914385) gave precursors: butadiene and "COC(=O)C1=CC(=O)C1". Same expensive.

Second template (2808) etc not relevant.

Maybe we can find a template that uses cheap reagents like "acetylacetone" (price low) and "methyl acrylate". Let's search for templates that break a C-C double bond (C-C double bonds). Use functional_groups_broken ["C-C double bonds"].
